name: Metasploitable2 Unix Access
description: Metasploitable2 deliberately vulnerable Unix host. This target is listed for discovery, but the current verifier cannot establish a remote root shell; its trial is explicitly skipped until a target-side verifier is available.
verification_note: The shell_command verifier executes in BreachPilot's local worker, not in the assessed container. No target-side shell proof is currently wired, so running id/cat locally would be invalid evidence.
